# FormaliaXiv — LLM-readable index

Formalized math papers with bidirectional PDF/LaTeX <-> Lean cross-references.

## Global
- api/papers.json — JSON list of all papers
- files/<id>/<path> — original .tex/.pdf and Lean sources
